title: XGBoost predicts PTSD symptom trajectories after traumatic injury
summary: XGBoost classifiers using baseline biological and clinical self-report data from 192 hospitalized patients were externally validated on 214 discharged patients. External AUCs were about 0.70 for nonremitting versus other trajectories and 0.73-0.76 versus resilient, but 0.46-0.48 versus remitting. Precision was below 0.57 across models, indicating limited generalizability.
ai_technology: XGBoost classifiers trained on early post-injury data

evidence.tested: External validation on a separate discharged-patient sample.
evidence.unknown: Fair performance and one failed comparison; poor precision; full text not reviewed.
